about.title: About
about.html:
INDEPENDENT BY DESIGN

BUILT AROUND THE AIRCRAFT.

MilPol Simulations is an independent flight simulation development project focused on bringing distinctive aircraft to Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. Our first programme is the Polish PZL W-3 Sokół family.

Explore the W-3 familyView development updates
W-3 SOKÓŁ / WORK IN PROGRESS
OUR APPROACH

DETAIL WITH PURPOSE.

We aim to recreate aircraft as coherent machines, not simply exterior models. That means researching their construction, cockpit layouts, equipment and operating characteristics, then developing those elements step by step.

RESEARCH FIRST

Available photographs, technical references and future first-hand recordings inform our work. Where references are incomplete, we continue researching rather than presenting assumptions as confirmed facts.

PROGRESS, NOT PROMISES

We share work in progress and distinguish planned features from completed systems. Our aim is to publish meaningful development updates approximately every two months, when progress allows.

INDEPENDENT DEVELOPMENT

Built by a small independent team, with an emphasis on careful modelling, research and systems work.

OUR FIRST PROGRAMME

THE W-3 SOKÓŁ FAMILY.

The initial package is planned to include the analogue W-3 and W-3RM Anakonda. The W-3PL Głuszec and W-3WARM Anakonda are planned as a later expansion. All variants remain in development; specifications and release plans may evolve.

Explore the W-3 family
WHAT COMES NEXT

Our focus is completing the W-3 programme. Other aircraft may follow, but we will only announce firm plans when there is work to show.

FOLLOW THE BUILD

development.title: Development
development.html:
WIP
W-3 PROGRAMME / ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT

INSIDE THE
HANGAR.

Actual development work from the W-3 project. The aircraft is being built in Blender from individual components upward, with research and reference gathering continuing alongside modelling.

Development update schedule

We aim to publish development updates approximately every two months, sharing our progress on aircraft modelling, systems development and other milestones. Update timings may vary depending on development progress.

CURRENT WORK

THE W-3
TAKES SHAPE.

Current work includes the airframe, rotor head and landing gear. These are development assets, not a finished aircraft or final render.

CURRENT BUILD

Core airframe

The current Blender model establishes the overall W-3 proportions and major external geometry while individual mechanical components are developed in parallel.

Current status: early 3D modelling and reference-driven component development.
COMPONENT WORK

DETAIL,
ONE PART AT A TIME.

Small mechanical components are being built and animated individually so the finished aircraft can have functional, believable assemblies.

ROADMAP

WHAT
COMES NEXT.

The project will progress through major development stages without fixed deadlines.

01 / FOUNDATION

Research & foundations

Reference gathering, core geometry and development framework.

02 / AIRCRAFT

W-3 & W-3RM development

Build the first two release aircraft with their own interiors, systems and mission equipment.

03 / SYSTEMS

Systems, flight model & testing

Implement helicopter dynamics, engines, avionics, animations and MSFS 2024 integration.

04 / RELEASE

W-3 + W-3RM initial release

The baseline W-3 and W-3RM form the first release package.

05 / EXPANSION

Paid W-3 family expansion

Continue the remaining variants using the established W-3 platform.

06 / COMPLETE

W-3PL + W-3WARM small-fee add-on

Complete the family with the W-3PL and W-3WARM as a separate expansion available for a small additional fee.

DEVELOPMENT STANDARD

QUALITY
OVER
DEADLINES.

The roadmap shows direction, not promises of dates. Research, modelling, systems and testing will develop at their own pace, with the aircraft taking priority over an artificial schedule.

The website will change as the aircraft changes.
NOVEMBER 2026 · DEVELOPMENT

support.title: Support
support.html:
MILPOL / SUPPORT

FAQ & SUPPORT

Answers to common questions about MilPol Simulations, the W-3 project and your account.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What is MilPol Simulations?

MilPol Simulations is a small independent team developing aircraft for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. Our first project is the PZL W-3 Sokół family.

Which W-3 variants are planned?

The initial package is planned to include the analogue W-3 and W-3RM Anakonda. The W-3PL Głuszec and W-3WARM Anakonda are planned for a later expansion. Plans may change.

When will the W-3 be released?

There is no confirmed release date. We will announce timing when development and testing are sufficiently advanced.

Will the aircraft work in MSFS 2020?

The current project targets Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. We have not announced an MSFS 2020 version.

How often are development updates published?

We aim to share meaningful development updates approximately every two months, depending on progress.

Can I vote on the next MilPol project?

Yes. Visit What Comes Next? and sign in to your MilPol account to vote for a potential future aircraft. The poll is advisory, not a promise of a future release.

How can I report an issue or contact the team?

You can contact the community team through the official MilPol Discord or Instagram links below. Please avoid posting passwords or private account details publicly.

Where can I manage my account?

Use the Sign In or Account link in the navigation. For account access problems, use the password-reset option on the sign-in page.

NEED MORE HELP?

Join our community or contact us using our official channels.

AIRCRAFT TECHNICAL PROFILE

W-3 Sokół / The adaptable foundation

A Polish twin-engine, four-bladed helicopter built for utility flying, passenger transport and specialist missions. The baseline Sokół is the starting point for the wider W-3 family.

RoleUtility, transport and multi-role operations
PowerplantTwo PZL-10W turboshaft engines
RotorFour-blade main rotor
Flight crewTypically two pilots; cabin arrangements vary

WHAT SETS THIS VARIANT APART

Analogue flight deck

Traditional flight and engine instruments provide the classic Sokół cockpit experience.

Configurable airframe

Different nose arrangements, lighting positions and mission fittings distinguish real W-3 configurations.

Multi-role cabin

The aircraft can be configured around transport and specialist tasks rather than one fixed mission.

MilPol development scope

The initial package is planned to include the baseline W-3 and W-3RM. The W-3 is intended to offer distinct exterior configurations where reference material supports them.

Real-world specifications describe the aircraft family and may vary by airframe. Simulator features are planned unless explicitly marked complete.
